notes.title: May Update, Week #2!
notes.content:
Hello all, if you prefer this update in video form, here is a link to the YouTube video.
[previewyoutube=6iQGCyzAFQ8;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6iQGCyzAFQ8&ab_channel=CatIsland[/previewyoutube]

Let's get straight into the update!

[h1]Artwork[/h1]
Ruben has been hard at work producing new models!
[list]
[*] Fences for our stockpiles
[*] New workbench model
[*] New tool bench model
[*] New roofing models (Peaks and sloped)
[*] Sloped blocks
[*] Spruce trees
[*] Two chair models
[*] A nice, large table
[*] And he touched up some plants
[/list]

[h1]New Additions[/h1]
We've been doing a lot of work under the hood but we'll start with our additions!

[h2]Detailing System[/h2]
The detailing system is done and implemented! It took a ton of planning to implement it seamlessly but players can now place objects such as the previously mentioned chairs and tables anywhere without the limitation of the voxel grid. This allows for very detailed buildings and tons of customization!

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
We have made the decision to switch from P2P connections using Steam to using Unity's built in transport layer. This was a big choice but ultimately we decided to drop Steam's implementation to speed up our development time. Steam does not support two instances of a game open at once and since even the editor counts as an instance you would need two separate computers to test. Previously it would take upwards of an hour to test and fix one bug! Now we can do that in less then a minutes.

I have been hard at work making our existing systems compatible with Multiplayer but so far only player movement and world syncing is implemented. I hope to have the rest transferred over by the end of the week!

[h2]Dialogue System[/h2]
The dialogue system is done! Writing new dialogue is as simple as creating a new json file. The current system not only supports any amount of NPCs, but it also allows for branching dialogue and conditional topics. For example an NPC may only talk to you about certain parts of the island if you've already explored it! While the system is great I would like to develop a new tool to easily visualize dialogue trees and create new ones quickly.

[h2]More Progression[/h2[
We have slowly but surely extended the first part of the game. With our new dialogue system we have allowed the player to speak to Onyx and implemented a new HUD element to show the player's current objective!

[h1]Other Topics[/h1]
I'm happy to announce we've created both a Facebook group and a Twitter account!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100092637129536]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/PurpleXStudios]Twitter[/url] 

If you want more frequent updates follow us on there! If you want to see these post in video format make sure to subscribe to our YouTube channel!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@catislandteam]YouTube[/url]

Don't forget to Wishlist Cat Island on Steam for updates, demos, and for access to our testing weeks!

Thank you all,
Purple X Studios

notes.title: April Update!
notes.content:
Hello everybody, Brian here with a Monthly Update on Cat Island!

This month we have put a lot of effort into organizing our team and structuring our workflow. Meet our team!

Project Lead / Developer - Brian Mills Jr.
Creative Director - Catmom4
3D Asset Creator - Rubeno
2D Illustrators - Doffito-K, Talha kun

With this team we are confident in a release by the end of the year. Let's first look at what we've accomplished so far. The custom voxel system for Cat Island has been completely finished along with crafting, AI, contracts, and much more! We are very ahead of schedule with the major systems however much of are art assets are slightly behind especially with the 2D elements. Adding a second Illustrator should help us catch up though so stay hopeful! 

This month has been spent finalizing our art direction and preparing for a small alpha test! Many hours have been spent perfect voxel textures and polishing various systems. On top of this a major effort was put into optimizing many systems such as chunk rendering, loading new regions, generation, etc. Before the end of the month we plan to have an official date for our alpha test as well as submissions for a chance to test! Make sure to wishlist Cat Island for future updates and share with your friends!

Thanks,
The Purple X Studios Team
